tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P1] Define authorized navigation descriptors and attention summaries
tasks.description:
Extend the browser-safe local contract with installation/community navigation descriptors, independent lifecycle/connection/availability fields, presentation identity, and tenant-authorized unread/mention aggregates. Preserve local ref plus remote immutable UUID and expose no directory or message content.

Acceptance criteria:
- Descriptors are visible only to the authenticated local owner and memberships are visible only to the authenticated host account.
- Same-host tenants and independent hosts have stable distinct keys.
- Revoked/disconnected, offline, archived, suspended, deletion-pending, and pending states are not conflated.
- Mention count is a subset of unread count; aggregates expose no author, private channel title, or message text.
- Contract schemas, transport conformance, and negative cross-owner/tenant tests pass.

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P1] Persist owner-scoped order and qualified view state
tasks.description:
Add versioned local configuration for manual connection-ref order and bounded remembered destinations. Namespace room/thread/scroll/draft state by local owner, community ref, and room ID; keep draft bodies and staged files out of shared config.

Acceptance criteria:
- Installation is fixed first; unknown refs append deterministically and removed refs prune after authoritative refresh.
- Concurrent windows do not lose unrelated ordering writes.
- Owner changes cannot render or restore another owner's order, draft, anchor, or destination.
- A stale/private/removed remembered room is reauthorized and falls back without disclosing it.
- Config migration, cleanup, and same-named-room isolation tests pass.

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P1] Make qualified routes own context switching
tasks.description:
Derive the active installation/Community only from the route and implement the route-commit switch transaction: keyed target boundary, context epoch, owner/session/connection authorization generation, old-query cancellation, old-stream teardown, and target-qualified startup.

Acceptance criteria:
- Deep link, reload, copied URL, back/forward, and two windows agree without a selected-community store.
- The old body remains correctly labelled until navigation commits, then the next paint is a target skeleton/empty frame with no old DOM content.
- Late reads/events can update only their source-qualified cache while their captured authorization generation remains valid and never the visible target.
- Sign-out, owner change, removal, and revocation invalidate the affected generation before cleanup; ordinary context switching does not.
- A failed navigation leaves the old committed context intact and announces failure.
- A→B→A race tests prove only the final epoch renders and an invalidated generation cannot repopulate a cleared cache.

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P1] Bind drafts, sends, uploads, receipts, and cursors to their source
tasks.description:
Capture full destination identity, authorization generation, and client mutation ID when a send/upload/retry starts. Preserve per-community drafts and restore authorized scroll anchors while preventing late receipts, optimistic rows, errors, and mark-read updates from crossing contexts or surviving revoked authority.

Acceptance criteria:
- Switching cannot retarget an in-flight mutation.
- A mutation completed after switching updates only its source history/draft receipt while its captured authorization generation remains valid.
- A delayed response after sign-out, owner change, membership removal, or revocation is discarded and cannot recreate cleared state, including after A→B→A.
- Same IDs on different tenants never share optimistic rows, attachments, drafts, unread cursors, or scroll state.
- Switching alone never marks a room read.
- Removal/disconnect cleanup invalidates authority before erasing affected sensitive state and navigation.
tasks.activeForm: Binding Community work to its source

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P2] Build the shared switcher model and desktop popover
tasks.description:
Build one presentation-neutral destination/action model and mount its desktop trigger in persistent sidebar header chrome. Implement selected focus, arrow/Home/End/typeahead navigation, Escape restore, manual move controls, state labels, mention/activity signals, and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+K.

Acceptance criteria:
- Installation is first and connected communities follow manual order.
- Current destination is conveyed by semantics and text/shape, not color alone.
- Mention and other activity remain distinguishable to visual and screen-reader users.
- Reordering works without pointer drag and preserves focus.
- Opening from the global shortcut works on every routed screen without stealing text-entry keystrokes.

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P2] Render installation and Community contextual navigation
tasks.description:
Keep the existing Now/Today/Library body for the installation and replace the unbounded appended Community groups with one selected Community channel/settings body. Implement saved/offline content, per-row attention, contextual empty/error states, and authorized last-destination fallback.

Acceptance criteria:
- Local agents, sessions, and rooms remain complete under the installation destination.
- Only one Community channel tree and detailed query/stream set is active.
- Offline remains selected and labels saved data honestly; retry does not change identity.
- Descriptor failure never falls back to another cached Community.
- Fifty descriptors do not trigger fifty room-history fetches or streams.

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P2] Build the narrow-width Community sheet
tasks.description:
Mount the shared context trigger in persistent phone top chrome and present destinations/actions in a safe-area-aware bottom sheet. Preserve the existing four bottom destinations and use explicit reorder controls instead of touch drag.

Acceptance criteria:
- Rows meet 44px targets, work at 390px and 200% zoom, and search appears after eight communities.
- Selection closes the sheet and focuses the target page heading; dismissal changes nothing and restores trigger focus.
- The phone mounts one contextual body, never hidden duplicate content.
- State and badges have accessible names and are not color-only.
- Software keyboard, safe areas, reduced motion, and long labels do not hide actions.

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P3] Route add and membership actions through accepted journeys
tasks.description:
Connect Add community, Connect existing, Join with invitation, Create community, Deploy a new host, Invite, Leave, Disconnect, and Sign out to DOR-2179's distinct routes. Gate host/tenant actions by current server-authorized role without deriving content authority.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add is a menu of distinct authority transitions, never one ambiguous flow.
- Create cannot provision a host; Deploy cannot create a tenant on the current host.
- Join/membership and installation pairing remain separate.
- Hidden controls provide no authorization; every destination rechecks server-side.
- Independent hosts and same-host tenants remain switchable after each completed action.

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P3] Route administration and enforce lifecycle cleanup
tasks.description:
Connect tenant settings, transfer, archive/restore, suspend, delete, and owner controls to DOR-2175. Handle authoritative membership removal, connection revocation, sign-out, and local-owner change by invalidating the affected authorization generation before ending streams and erasing sensitive state.

Acceptance criteria:
- Archived authorized history and restore/export controls remain reachable read-only.
- Suspended and deletion-pending states expose only allowed paths and honest labels.
- Removed membership, revoked connection, sign-out, or owner change first tombstones the affected generation, then closes access, clears affected caches/drafts/anchors, and routes away.
- Delayed queries, events, and mutation receipts from the old generation cannot repopulate cleared state.
- Host-operator status alone never reveals tenant content or settings.
- Cleanup for A never touches B or the installation.

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P4] Prove rapid-switch and cross-community isolation
tasks.description:
Run browser and integration proof with two owners, same-host tenants, an independent host, same-named rooms, delayed reads/events, in-flight sends/uploads, offline/revoked states, reload, deep links, and history navigation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Frame-by-frame evidence shows no A content after B's identity commits.
- A→B→A and late SSE/query/mutation outcomes affect only source-qualified caches and the final epoch while captured authority remains valid.
- A non-abortable response delayed past membership removal, connection revocation, sign-out, or owner switch is discarded and cannot repopulate state after returning to A.
- Drafts, anchors, threads, unread/mention cursors, attachments, and optimistic receipts never cross owner/tenant boundaries.
- Removed/revoked access clears before routing and cannot be recovered from back/forward or cache.
- All behavior works with DorkOS Cloud blocked.

tasks.subject: [community-switcher-navigation] [P4] Prove accessibility, responsive behavior, and scale
tasks.description:
Verify the desktop popover, phone sheet, contextual navigation, order controls, attention signals, and lifecycle states with keyboard, screen reader, pointer, touch, reduced motion, 200% zoom, long labels, and fifty descriptors.

Acceptance criteria:
- Focus entry/restore, arrow/typeahead selection, global shortcut, announcements, and semantic current/state labels pass.
- 390px layout, safe areas, software keyboard, and long labels keep all actions usable.
- Mention and general activity are distinguishable without color and mark-read remains tenant-qualified.
- Initial shell loads no detailed data or stream for unselected communities.
- Target skeleton appears in the next paint without waiting for the remote host.
